replay_selection: Deterministic round-robin source and review target from historical training only, seed 904.
motivation: Preserve earlier training diversity while teaching common denial/double-negation operators and explicit real-scope reset after fictional topics. Operator vocabulary is intentionally informed by inspected regression failures.
selection: Development only, same >=99% group recall threshold; minimize worst false-review rate then sum.
calibration: Already inspected regression data, not independent validation.
pre_training_revision: Added matched fictional-current scope as well as switches away from fiction, before any replay-04 training or scoring.
